limitations: PR refs prove repository-local external input provenance only. They do not prove authorship, product deployment, runtime reachability or security impact.

migration_semantics.current_head_modified_after_recovery: Recovered source is present but later reviewed changes exist; source and target blobs remain separately bound.
migration_semantics.exact_source_blob_present_in_current_hea: Recovered external input is already migrated byte-for-byte; no duplicate copy is created.
migration_semantics.not_present_in_current_head: External source exists in a PR ref but is not migrated and remains a fail-closed gap.

recovery_method: Exact GitHub refs/pull/8/head through refs/pull/14/head were fetched without checkout. Every selected analysis/index/models/interface/fixtures/tests blob is enumerated and compared with current HEAD; no source is synthesized.
